chamada: What is yours on Alumia stays with you: download a copy whenever you want, or delete the account for good.

exportar.texto: A .zip file with everything you wrote and set up on Alumia, plus a page that opens in any browser, offline.

itens.escrito: Posts and replies, with earlier versions, drafts, scheduled posts and stories
itens.perfil: Profile, who you follow, communities, groups, saved posts, folders, muted and blocked
itens.arquivos: Your photos, audio and story videos, as files
itens.aparelho: The timelines you built on this device

exportar.terceiros: About other people, only numbers, and only from 3 up. Who liked, followed, replied to or muted you does not appear in the copy.
exportar.regra: One copy per day. The file is built on the spot, goes straight to your device and is not kept on the server.
exportar.jaHoje: You already downloaded today's copy. Another one tomorrow.
exportar.linksTemporarios: Some large files came as a temporary address, valid for {horas} hour. Open the file's page soon to keep them.

apagar.texto: There is one account for the Institute and Alumia: deleting here deletes both.

passos.agora: Right away, the account leaves the network: the profile, posts and stories go offline, and the Fediverse receives the removal of what had gone there.
passos.prazo: For {dias} days you can change your mind, right here.
passos.fim: When the period ends, everything is deleted for good: posts, photos and audio, profile, keys and preferences.

apagar.outras: Where other people replied to or quoted you, only a “deleted post” mark remains, without your name or your text, so their conversation does not vanish too.
apagar.registro: Moderation decisions already taken stay in the moderation record, which is never deleted: it is the proof of the process.
apagar.baixeAntes: Want to keep something? Download the copy first.
apagar.palavraDica: Exactly as shown here, with the @.
apagar.funcao: People with a role at the Institute ask the coordination for deletion.
apagar.marcadoTexto: Your account has already left the network. It will be deleted for good on {quando}.
apagar.faltaPouco: The period ends in less than a day.
apagar.cancelar: Change my mind and keep the account
apagar.cancelado: Done: your account is back on the network.
apagar.canceladoFediverso: The Fediverse was left off. If you want, turn it on again on the Fediverse screen.
apagar.noPrazo: While the period runs, the account does not post, does not post stories and does not follow anyone.

codigo.texto: Type the 6-digit code that shows in the app right now.
codigo.errado: That code does not match. Look at the app again and type the code on screen now.
codigo.semFator: Your account does not have the authenticator app yet. Set it up at the Alumia entrance and come back.

erros.falha: That did not work right now. Try again in a moment.
erros.palavra: The word does not match. Type exactly {palavra}.
erros.prazoPassou: The period to change your mind is over.
erros.semServico: This part needs the Alumia server, which is not running here.

arquivo.comoLer: The file meus-dados.json has everything, in an open format any program reads. This page shows the same in an easy-to-read way. Nothing here fetches anything from the internet.
arquivo.terceiros: About other people, the copy brings only numbers, and only from 3 up. “Fewer than 3” means 0, 1 or 2.

sair.texto: You leave the network and your Institute account stays: courses, the panel and the rest of the site carry on as they are.

passos.agora: Right away you disappear from the network: your profile, posts and stories go offline, and the Fediverse receives the removal of whatever had reached it.
passos.prazo: For {dias} days you can change your mind, right here.
passos.fim: When the period ends, everything that belongs to Alumia is removed for good: posts, photos and audio, your network profile, who you follow and who follows you, communities and conversations.

sair.ficam: What stays: your Institute account, moderation decisions already taken and any sanction currently in force. To come back to Alumia later, you need to ask to join again.
sair.funcao: People who administer Alumia ask the coordination to leave.
sair.marcadoTexto: You have already left the network. Leaving is complete on {quando}; your Institute account stays.
sair.cancelar: Change my mind and go back to the network
